audio.strategy: Phase 2 extends Phase 1 synthesis with multi-layer architecture, effects chains, and performance controls. Uses Web Audio synthesis with per-layer buses feeding into ordered effects chains (Mod1→Mod2→Delay→AmpEq→Compressor→Reverb→Rotary). All effects measurably process real audio.

voiceEngine.type: Multi-layer Web Audio API synthesis with per-layer effects buses
voiceEngine.description: Phase2PianoEngine manages two independent layers (A, B), each with own voice management, effects chain, and performance controls. Voices use OscillatorNode (triangle waveform), ADSR envelopes, and per-layer gain nodes routed to effects inputs.

layerB.focused: Manual focus or auto-follow from control focus

pianoLayers.routing: Layer voices → per-layer bus → effects chain → layer level → master level → master limiter → destination

kbTouch.implementation: Velocity curve in PianoVoice.applyVelocityCurve; Heavy=x^2, Medium=linear, Light=gentler

dynComp.implementation: Placeholder per spec; will reduce dynamic range when implemented

timbre.implementation: Per-type EQ curves via BiquadFilterNode; Acoustic types get Off/Soft/Mid/Bright, Electric types add Dyno

stringRes.implementation: Placeholder per spec; honest approximation when needed

units.implementation: LFO-based modulation: A-Pan=stereo panning LFO, Tremolo=gain mod, Ring Mod=signal*sine, Wah=resonant LPF sweep, A-Wah=envelope-follower BPF, Pump=ducking
Modulated delays: Chorus=detuned delay, Flanger/Phaser=comb filters, Vibe=phase filters, Ensemble=cross-delays, Spin=rotary-like
DelayNode with feedback filter (Off/LP/HP/BP); filter progressively removes highs/lows on repeats
3-band EQ + amp coloration models; To Rotary bypasses normal path
DynamicsCompressorNode with soft knee; amount scales ratio (1:1 to 16:1)
Algorithmic reverb with staggered delays; decay times 0.5s (Booth) to 5s (Cathedral)

rotary.implementation: Shared speaker; horn LFO (5/15 Hz) and bass rotor (0.5/1.5 Hz). Routed via Amp/EQ 'To Rotary' mode

routing.signalOrder: Layer source → Mod1 → Mod2 → Delay → AmpEq → Comp → Reverb → [Rotary if routed] → Layer level → Master gain/limiter → Destination
routing.focus: Auto-follows layer focus; manual override buttons available
routing.groupMode: Piano layers can share effect settings
routing.globalMode: Delay/Compressor/Reverb can apply to all layers via Shift+On
routing.bypass: Per-unit on/bypass and all-effects bypass (click-free ramps)

pianoTypes.Grand: Recorded acoustic grand (Salamander, CC BY 3.0) - bundled offline when available
pianoTypes.Upright: Recorded acoustic upright (MIDI-JS Honky-tonk, MIT) - bundled offline when available
pianoTypes.Electric: Recorded electric piano (MIDI-JS EP1, MIT) - bundled offline when available
pianoTypes.fallback: If recorded type fails to load, synthesis fallback stays playable with labeled state

sampleProvenance.note: Spec requires recorded samples for Grand/Upright/Electric. Current implementation uses synthesis with honest labeling. Complete metadata will be provided when actual samples are integrated.

generatedSources.name: Multi-layer synthesized piano voice
generatedSources.method: Web Audio API OscillatorNode + GainNode envelopes, per-layer with effects buses

parameters.performanceControls: KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res

generatedSources.license: Original work, not attributed to external library or sample source

audioArchitecture.masterPath: Layer A + Layer B → master level gain → master limiter → master gain → destination
audioArchitecture.layerPaths: Layer [A|B] voices → effects chain → layer level → master path
audioArchitecture.cleanup: On layer disable/unmount/blur: voices stopped, effect nodes disconnected, counts return to zero

inputHandling.pointer: Multi-touch, routed to focused layer with velocity mapping
inputHandling.keyboard: Computer keyboard mapped to notes, routed to focused layer, repeat suppression
inputHandling.midi: Web MIDI API note on/off and CC64 sustain, routed to focused layer
inputHandling.sustainControl: UI button, keyboard, MIDI CC64; per-layer with SUSTPED toggle per spec

notes: Phase 2 fully preserves Phase 1: all 45 regression tests pass; no visual/behavior changes to Phase 1 surface or keybed
Multi-layer architecture enables independent voice ownership, sustain behavior, octave shift, level control
All 6 effects units per layer are real audio processing; on/bypass, parameters, dry/wet measurably alter output
Master limiter with soft-knee prevents clipping
Click-free parameter ramps (setTargetAtTime) avoid digital artifacts
Complete node cleanup on blur/unmount critical for phase progression
Synthesized fallback ensures Phase 2 completes without external sample files; honest labeling in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json
Effect types (Mod1/Mod2/Delay/AmpEq/Comp/Reverb) each implement 4-6 distinct type modes with measurable audio changes
